create_aloha_task: create an AlohaTask subclass to define a new bimanual robot manipulation task in MuJoCo
convert_gripper_values: convert gripper values between sim_qpos, sim_ctrl, follower, and leader coordinate spaces
define_arena_scene: build an Arena to load and configure the MuJoCo scene XML with camera and table offsets
configure_observables: configure AlohaObservables to expose joints_pos, joints_vel, and physics_state for the robot
customize_action_spec: customize the action_spec to set waist joint limits and gripper range for the robot
